news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire™ to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.source: PR Newswire / Perimeter Medical Imaging IR
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI system, installing it at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital in Utah for real-time intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment. The deployment marks Claire's transition from clinical trial use to everyday clinical practice and gives Perimeter a marquee reference site for its broader hospital sales pipeline.

news.headline: Perimeter Announces Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
news.summary: Perimeter confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial and operating results after market close on Thursday, August 20, 2026, followed by a management webcast and conference call covering commercial progress on Claire.

news.headline: Brookline starts Perimeter at buy; PT C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets initiated coverage of Perimeter with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, citing the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire as the first AI-enabled imaging device cleared for intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital names Perimeter and maintains Profound as healthcare Top Picks
news.summary: Paradigm Capital added Perimeter as a new Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and C$0.95 price target, saying the FDA approval sets the company up to accelerate commercial rollout, while flagging a possible year-end Medicare reimbursement decision and management commentary about a potential Nasdaq listing.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Perimeter reports Q2 2026 financial and operating results after market close with a management webcast/conference call, the first major update since the Intermountain Health deployment.

catalysts.label: Medicare (CMS) reimbursement decision for Claire
catalysts.detail: Analysts (Paradigm Capital) flagged a possible Medicare reimbursement determination for Claire OCT+AI near year-end 2026, which would be a major driver of hospital adoption economics.

catalysts.label: Potential Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: Management has reportedly discussed a possible move to Nasdaq from the TSXV/OTCQX, per sell-side commentary; no formal filing or date has been announced by the company.

catalysts.label: Expansion of Claire hospital placements
catalysts.detail: Following the Intermountain Health go-live, Perimeter is working a reported pipeline of roughly 50 hospital leads for additional Claire placements beyond the initial Utah sites.

pulse: Perimeter is moving from clinical validation to early commercial execution: its FDA PMA-approved Claire OCT+AI system went live for the first time in routine surgical practice via a landmark systemwide deployment at Intermountain Health (Aug 13, 2026), and sell-side coverage turned more constructive in July with Buy/Top Pick calls from Brookline Capital Markets (C$1.54 PT) and Paradigm Capital (C$0.95 PT). The stock is a thinly-traded MedTech micro-cap where the near-term story hinges on translating the Intermountain reference win into further hospital placements from its ~50-lead pipeline, with Q2 2026 results (Aug 20, 2026) the next concrete checkpoint and a possible year-end Medicare reimbursement decision and Nasdaq uplisting cited as longer-dated, unconfirmed catalysts.
